Another local Claude session (repos-91, session local-ee-drafter) drafted one sentence and 1-5 interior anchors per body from OPUS's pack (`mem_pack.py`, filtered against engine_explained's own set); OPUS checked every row mechanically with `interior_ingest.py` (member mode). A second local agent, not the drafter, then read every one of the 154 rows of this batch against the disassembly: 150 stood, 4 rows were corrected in 4 clauses (three signed compares worded above/below, one operand grouping).
